title: Convolution Meets LoRA: Parameter Efficient Finetuning for Segment Anything Model
mechanism: LoRA bottleneck with lightweight convolution experts gated per scale (MoE), injecting a local image prior into SAM's plain ViT.
adaptation: Conv-LoRA rank 8-32 in SAM ViT-B/L at 1024, prompt-free multi-class decoder; local conv prior targets the 16 px patch blind spot for 2 px cracks.
evidence: R: beats LoRA and adapters across medical, natural, agriculture, remote sensing segmentation (ICLR 2024).
min_experiment: Conv-LoRA vs plain LoRA on SAM ViT-L @1024, 3 seeds; metric crack IoU and recall on components < 20 px; kill if gain over LoRA < 0.012 crack IoU.
prior_overlap: none; LoRA/adapters listed as not closed.

alt_notes.adaptation: Same harness as TopoLoRA-SAM arm; swap LoRA for Conv-LoRA; local prior is what 1-2 px cracks on a 4 px dark line need.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Conv-LoRA SAM vs LoRA SAM vs house PF, 5-fold CV; default kill line.
